briefdescription.para: Return the cost of duplicating a piece of this block from first non-phi and before StopAt instruction to thread across it.

detaileddescription.para: Stop scanning the block when exceeding the threshold. If duplication is impossible, returns ~0U.

inbodydescription.para: Ignore PHI nodes, these will be flattened when duplication happens.

briefdescription.para: getKnownConstant - Helper method to determine if we can thread over a terminator with the given value as its condition, and if so what value to use for that.

detaileddescription.para: What kind of value this is depends on whether we want an integer or a block address, but an undef is always accepted. Returns null if Val is null or not an appropriate constant.

briefdescription.para: GetBestDestForBranchOnUndef - If we determine that the specified block ends in an undefined jump, decide which block is best to revector to.

detaileddescription.para: Since we can pick an arbitrary destination, we pick the successor with the fewest predecessors. This should reduce the in-degree of the others.

briefdescription.para: Return true if Op is an instruction defined in the given block.
findMostPopularDest - The specified list contains multiple possible threadable destinations.

detaileddescription.para: Pick the one that occurs the most frequently in the list.

briefdescription.para: addPHINodeEntriesForMappedBlock - We're adding 'NewPred' as a new predecessor to the PHIBB block.

detaileddescription.para: If it has PHI nodes, add entries for NewPred using the entries from OldPred (suitably mapped).
